parsed.g: List products from the PS4 accessories category sorted by ascending price
P_t: Navigated to the Video Games category (step 1)
Navigated to the PS4 Accessories category page at http://172.185.52.29:7770/video-games/playstation-4/accessories.html (step 7 via goto)
Confirmed the correct PS4 Accessories category page is loaded with 228 items (step 8)
Opened the Sort By dropdown on the PS4 Accessories page and identified the 'Price' menuitem [12809] (step 8-9)
Clicked the 'Price' menuitem [12809] to sort by price ascending (step 9)
R_t: Verify that the page has reloaded with products sorted by ascending price (the click on Price in step 9 should trigger a reload with product_list_order=price&product_list_dir=asc)
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM at step 9 shows the PS4 Accessories category page (http://172.185.52.29:7770/video-games/playstation-4/accessories.html) with 228 items displayed in grid view. The Sort By dropdown still shows 'Position' as selected (selected='selected') and 'Price' as unselected. The sort direction link reads 'Set Descending Direction' indicating current direction is ascending. The page lists 12 products in default position order: Skinit Mickey Mouse ($29.99), Wireless Game Controller Golden ($23.95), Skinit NFL LA Rams ($16.99), 5Pcs HDMI Port Socket ($13.29), FOTTCZ Anti-Slip Silicone ($17.99), DLseego PS5 Console Cover ($38.99), MMOBIEL Blu-Ray Laser ($30.99), Eboxer 5Pcs 3D Joystick ($8.37), Skinit Disney Stitch ($29.99), NexiGo PS5 Accessories ($49.00), PS4 Controller Skin Silicone ($10.99), Oussirro Wireless PS4 Remote ($26.99). The breadcrumb shows Home > Video Games > PlayStation 4 > Accessories. The user is not logged in (Sign In link present, no welcome message).
C: Must remain on the PS4 Accessories category page (http://172.185.52.29:7770/video-games/playstation-4/accessories.html)
Sort direction must be ascending (asc) when applying price sort
Must not navigate away from the correct PS4 Accessories subcategory

F_t.action: Clicked Accessories filter [7897] on the general Video Games page (step 3)
F_t.cause: This applied a category filter for 'Accessories' on the general Video Games page, not the PS4-specific Accessories subcategory. The resulting page was Video Games filtered by Accessories (228 items) rather than the PS4 Accessories subcategory URL.
Hovering did not navigate to the PS4 Accessories page; the agent was still on the wrong filtered Video Games page.

F_t.action: Clicked Sort By combobox [9558] on the wrong page (step 5)
F_t.cause: The agent was still on the general Video Games Accessories filtered page, not the PS4-specific Accessories subcategory.

F_t.action: Clicked Price menuitem [9716] on the wrong page (step 6)
F_t.cause: This sorted by price on the general Video Games Accessories filtered page (not the PS4 Accessories subcategory). The DOM confirms the page title was 'Video Games' not 'Accessories - PlayStation 4 - Video Games'.

F_t.action: Clicked Sort By combobox [12658] on the correct PS4 Accessories page (step 8)
F_t.cause: The click on the combobox opened the dropdown but did not change the sort order. The DOM at step 9 still shows 'Position' as selected='selected' and 'Price' as unselected, confirming the sort was not yet applied.

K_t: The correct PS4 Accessories category URL is http://172.185.52.29:7770/video-games/playstation-4/accessories.html (category ID 236)
The PS4 Accessories category contains 228 items
The Sort By dropdown on the PS4 Accessories page has options: Position (value='position'), Product Name (value='name'), Price (value='price')
The current sort direction is ascending (the direction link says 'Set Descending Direction' with data-value='desc')
The toolbar form uses URL parameters: product_list_order for sort field and product_list_dir for direction
Clicking the Price menuitem [12809] at step 9 should trigger a page reload with price sorting applied
The ground-truth DOM at step 9 still shows Position as selected, meaning the price sort click has not yet taken effect in the rendered DOM
